finding_reviews.rationale: Independently read F28 output: fund=True;holdings=False at 2026-06-30. DuckDB grouping finds holdings only through 2026-03-31. June fund financials hold assets 6,330,562,000, liabilities 3,238,748,000, net assets 3,091,814,000 and investments FV 5,980,632,000. Original consolidated balance sheet current column and current schedule agree in thousands; 5,980,632 / 3,091,814 gives the printed 193.43%, while 6,113,030 is cost. December 2025 is comparative, and Keystone subsidiary totals are separate. F28 tests quarter presence, with no ratio denominator. The report correctly proposes including cached June holdings when a build is separately authorized, rather than alleging a proven parser failure or weakening the rule. Coverage key 0001851322/2026-06-30/F28:fund_financials_holdings_coverage.

observation_reviews.rationale: Original LUV context-bearing row prints Common Equity, 1,383 shares, cost 1,331 thousand and FV 936 thousand under Diversified Consumer Services. Its context member instead identifies FORTIS preferred under Commercial Services & Supplies, and publication follows the stale class/name plus 4,000,000 proxy shares. The separate FORTIS row really is preferred with 4,000,000 shares and different amounts. Reverse explicit common-versus-published-preferred checking is a justified proposed detector; current preferred_printed only tests published common rows. Context and amount alignment are necessary false-positive guards; a neighboring heading or borrower-name match is insufficient. This is a proposal, not a validated detector implementation.

limitations: The 23 previously reviewed findings remain excluded. No whole-fund acceptance, repair, rebuild, tests or disposition was performed.
Source comparison establishes printed versus published discrepancies; proposed repair mechanisms and detector are not implementation-validated.
Selected review completeness is not data correctness. No systematic audit of unselected positions or rate fields was performed.
